decision.reason: CPL2 likelihood is the cleaner load-bearing measurement. Stage 18 shows free-form generated text is a lossy surface channel, not that the eta-to-epsilon bridge failed. The product should claim semantic likelihood influence, not exact sentence forcing.

one_sentence_claim: CAS Harness reads bounded CAS cognitive structure from open-model hidden activations, validates the readout with controls, flags blind spots, and packages the evidence so a reviewer can verify what was measured and what was not claimed.

control_and_black_box_boundary.output_influence_claim: CAS Harness influences the host model's semantic likelihood through readable realization. That is output influence at the probability-distribution level.
control_and_black_box_boundary.not_claimed_output_boundary: Current evidence does not show exact sentence forcing in free-form decoding.
control_and_black_box_boundary.black_box_claim: CAS Harness materially opens bounded parts of the black box by reading cognitive structure from hidden activations, validating the readout, tracing stability and blind spots, and packaging the evidence with provenance and controls.
control_and_black_box_boundary.not_claimed_black_box_boundary: Current evidence does not provide a complete neuron-by-neuron causal explanation of the whole model.

supported_capabilities.meaning: CAS can recover bounded CAS labels from open-model activations.
The activation readout beats text and/or metadata baselines on claim-bearing fixtures.
Targeted subspace removal collapses the trained readout while random removals do not.
CAS can flag weak, drifting, or conflicted readout paths.
CAS can inspect whether learned CAS subspaces align with static output geometry above random.
Readable CAS realization shifts semantic likelihood across Pythia, OLMo, and Qwen.

stage18_visible_text.interpretation: Visible free-form generated text is not established. This is a surface-channel null, not evidence against CPL2 likelihood conditioning.

visible_generation_badge.reason: Stage 18 returned a clean visible-text null.

reviewer_workflow: Read the claim badge and boundary.
Verify model revision and fixture SHA.
Verify the pre-registration predates the result.
Confirm layer selection used validation data only.
Inspect ablation and random controls if the claim is causal.
Inspect raw-symbol controls if prefix conditioning is claimed.
Check rejected claims before quoting the result externally.

implementation_target.ui: reviewer drawer with claim badge, provenance, readout, controls, blind spots, caveats, and export
